decisions.text: type thin_bar: individual irregular events: thin bars at their instants on a true time axis, never a standard line (G1.54)
24 events as thin bars, each at its instant, 2.8 pt wide (D-42), rising from zero; nothing drawn between them
4 pairs of events closer in time than a bar's width: their bars touch or overlap, as on the book's concert chart (s. 0183)

events whose value is not known are marked by a note at their instant, wrapped first (the empty slots' procedure, owner, 1 Oct 2026): 9:20 AM, Dec. 18, 2025: above the bars beside it, with a thin leader down to its instant (the names' break rules, G2.4)
a true time axis (G2.42), the window given: 12:00 AM, Jan. 1, 2025 to 12:00 AM, Jan. 1, 2026
the unit phrase on the top label: “25 hours (length of each spill)”; the top gridline starts after it
a true time axis (G2.42): row 1 months, each centred on its span
time axis: row 2 (“2025”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
dates marked on the time axis, each a thin dark-grey line across the plot under the marks, its label the chart's own note beside it: June 15, 2025, “Storage tank finished”, labelled right of its top
the title wraps onto two lines
comment 1 (“The longest spill of the year, five mon…”) in empty space inside the plot, 1 arrow to spills at 2025-11-13T01:50 (G8.7)
the maker's comments in New Computer Modern italic, in the reserved blue, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (G6.3, D-19)
the four questions answered: what matters: the title (not answered: why care, what explains it, what to do, which need be answered only where known) (G8.3)

source.notes: evaluation round 1, B03 (opus-G, which fell back to monthly totals)
source.shows: individual events as thin bars, with the date the tank was finished marked on the axis (a thin line, its label beside it), the spill whose duration was not recorded noted clear of the bars beside it (above them, with a leader), and a comment pointing at one spill (SPEC §6.13.3, §6.13.12, §6.12.6)

path.name: brief
path.text: job answer: insight “The overflow spilled 8 times after the tank was finished in mid-June, including the longest spill of the year, 21¼ hours on 13 November”

path.name: values over time
path.text: an irregular series (event): individual irregular events: thin bars at their instants on a true time axis, never a standard line (G1.54)

path.name: avoid-list
path.text: thin bar charts are not on the avoid-list (G1.61)

path.name: avoid-list
path.text: thin bar charts may be new to a general audience: teach them (build the chart up, show first the familiar chart that fails, or add two or three callouts stating the obvious; G1.5), or state the insight in a sentence and keep the chart as backup (G1.6)
